schema.description: An applicant asks the community for the single-use challenge its hidden-vetting proof must be bound to. The community issues one per applicant and spends it when the proof is counted, so a proof cannot be submitted twice.

criterionId.description: OPTIONAL. The `id` of the admission criterion the coming submission answers. A community running one hidden-vetting criterion needs no hint; one running several may use it to refuse early rather than at submit.
